issues.title: Ingest Lee County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $6,452,873 across 15 funds. The largest: General Fund ($3,742,551), Road Fund ($2,206,669), District Court Clerk/All Courts ($165,857). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
